questions.subject: EUROPEAN_HISTORY
questions.topic: The village court that outlived the empire
questions.learningObjective: Explain how a village court outlived the empire
questions.stem: Projection 3101 asks how a village court outlived the empire.

options.text: A village court could persist after imperial collapse because local order rested on custom, not on the empire.
The empire's courts never reached villages.
Village courts ended when the empire fell.
Only royal courts survived the empire.

questions.explanation: A village court could outlive the empire because local order rested on custom rather than imperial institutions. The error is to assume total collapse or deny local continuity.

questions.subject: EUROPEAN_HISTORY
questions.stem: Projection 3102 asks what the second serfdom thesis claims.

The thesis denies any peasant freedom existed.

questions.explanation: The second serfdom thesis describes regional re-enserfment after 1500, not a universal claim. The error is to overgeneralise or misdate it.
